questions.stem: In a patient diagnosed with Familial Dilated Cardiomyopathy (FDC), genetic studies reveal mutations in genes encoding proteins crucial for maintaining cardiac adherens junctions. Which specific protein alteration is most likely to contribute to the pathogenesis of FDC?
